item.title: Daily digest — 2026-08-02
item.description:
Our community has seen significant activity across multiple projects, with notable connections between them. For instance, the `statcheck` project, led by MicheleNuijten, has been integrating changes to enhance its features, while `docpluck` has been resolving documentation and test issues, and `coarse` has been focusing on security and release audits. Meanwhile, `regcheck` has been addressing bugs and improving its demo page, and `escicheck` has synchronized changes with the `escicheckapp` repository, bringing it up to date with `effectcheck` version `0.6.14`. These efforts demonstrate the community's commitment to progress and collaboration, and we celebrate the achievements of our contributors, including MicheleNuijten, Gilad Feldman, David van Dijcke, and Jamie Cummins. Overall, our community is making great strides in advancing open-source research tools, and we look forward to seeing the continued impact of these projects.

item.title: scrutiny: activity update
item.description:
lhdjung/scrutiny

The `main` branch saw changes to the CITATION.cff file, with Lukas Jung updating it, and later adding a `date-released` field. The `gh-pages` branch was updated twice, with deployments from the `lhdjung/scrutiny` repository at specific commits, as indicated by the messages "Deploying to gh-pages from @ lhdjung/scrutiny@a81cd540332cf402c1ffc798f93534c31da17009" and "Deploying to gh-pages from @ lhdjung/scrutiny@0fd47d0e2ffee48a24c1806c4e4bcd2da5d4e238". Both deployments were marked with a rocket ship emoji, 🚀, indicating a successful deployment. Work was done on both the `main` and `gh-pages` branches.
